newsitem.title: POLAND: Polifarb W to vote on merger March 25.
newsitem.headline: Polifarb W to vote on merger March 25.

text.p: Shareholders of Polish paintmaker Polifarb Wroclaw SA will vote on March 25 on the firm's planned merger with Polifarb Cieszyn, Polifarb Wroclaw said in a statement on Friday.
On Thursday Polifarb Cieszyn said its shareholders would vote on March 24 on all necessary motions to merge with Wroclaw by taking over all of Wroclaw's assets.
Cieszyn said its shareholders would vote on a new scrip issue for current Cieszyn shareholders to match the number of Wroclaw's shares and on another rights share issue.

Cieszyn has said that under the plan it would raise its share capital by 2,978,820 shares to equal Wroclaw's 22,103,820 shares and set another issue for Wroclaw shareholders to facilitate a one-for-one share exchange to effect the merger.
The new entity, due to start operation in the second half of 1997, is expected to have about 40 percent of the market.
